name: interactive-terminal

test_list.description: Run the actual binary in a ConPTY at 80x24 and assert the empty offline welcome; initial draft is not submitted.
Launch with a valid initial draft, assert its visible and uncommitted state, clear it and exit without a commit.
Send a bracketed paste containing a valid directive and prove it appears as draft text without a commit receipt.
Type a valid standalone $websearch(on), submit it, and observe the kernel commit receipt in the real TUI.

Exit through /quit and observe bracketed-paste, alternate-screen, CSI-u keyboard and cursor bytes in ConPTY; Windows mouse mode bytes are checked by the direct CrosstermOps lifecycle test because ConPTY filters DECSET 100x.
After initial frame settles, capture an idle window and assert no extra terminal bytes.

inputs.name: pty session
inputs.description: Actual polaris executable launched with isolated state/workspace directories and finite terminal size.

output_type: Observed terminal bytes and process exit status
output_description: Real welcome, literal draft/commit behavior, and bounded terminal cleanup; capture capped at 2 MiB with deadlines.
